description: This Java class handles activation commands for share accounts in the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes activation commands, and delegates the activation logic to ShareAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ActivateShareAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles activation commands for share accounts, implementing processCommand to trigger the activation through the service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the activation command by delegating to the shareAccountWritePlatformService to activate the share account based on the entity ID and command details.
